arguments.summary: Privilege escalation detected on host WS-IT-101 (10.0.1.25) via exploitation of PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-34527). A malicious DLL was loaded by spoolsv.exe from C:\Windows\Temp\malicious.dll. Despite EDR and IDS visibility, no malicious artifacts were flagged during initial scans. Lateral movement attempts and suspicious activity were observed from another host (10.0.5.42), indicating potential broader campaign. Full scan of affected host returned clean, suggesting evasion or persistence outside traditional detection scope.
